This '''small and unremarkable star''' was located in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. At some point before the end of the [[Manderon Period]], an outside [[Unidentified Iokath species|species]] chose the star and its [[Iokath system/Legends|system]] to implement [[Project Iokath]]. Every orbital body in the system, down to the last asteroid, was demolished and salvaged for core elements to create a massive self-sustaining ecosphere that completely engulfed the star, utilizing 100% of its energy output. The massive habitat was named [[Iokath]] and since once completed it allowed no light from the star outside, the entire system became undetectable to the rest of the galaxy.<ref name="Codex" />
